text: AI-GENIE R package automated psychological scale development structural validation using large language models (LLMs) network psychometric methods. title: AIGENIE 2.1.0
text: Anthropic Claude support: Generate items using Claude Sonnet 4.5, Opus 4, Haiku 4.5 models via anthropic.API. Jina AI embeddings: Compute embeddings using Jina models (v2, v3, v4) via jina.API, including Matryoshka truncation task-specific adapters. Slash-style Groq models: Route HuggingFace-style model IDs (e.g., "meta-llama/llama-4-scout-17b-16e-instruct", "qwen/qwen3-32b") Groq groq.API provided. chat() function: Send arbitrary prompts supported LLM provider optional repetitions, temperature control, system role customization. list_available_models(): Query available models across providers, optional filtering type ("chat" "embedding"). Multi-provider mixing: Use one provider item generation another embeddings (e.g., Anthropic items + Jina embeddings).

title: AIGENIE 2.1.0
text: Comprehensive input validation across user-facing functions. Unified embedding dispatch via generate_embeddings() supporting OpenAI, Jina AI, HuggingFace (API local), sentence-transformers. Model alias resolution common shorthand names ("sonnet", "llama3", "deepseek", "qwen", etc.). Improved error messages provider-specific guidance.

title: AIGENIE 2.0.0
text: Complete rewrite pipeline architecture. Introduced GENIE() validation user-provided item sets (embedding → EGA → UVA → bootEGA). Added Groq API support open-source LLM item generation. Added local LLM support via llama-cpp-python (local_AIGENIE(), local_GENIE(), local_chat()). Python environment management via UV reticulate. HuggingFace embedding support (API local sentence-transformers).
